claim_text: Meghalaya had 2,966,889 people in the 2011 Census base used by the state DES portal: 2,371,439 rural and 595,450 urban.
logic_rationale: I use this only as a dated structural baseline, not as a current population estimate.

claim_text: The 2011 DES figures imply that 79.9% of Meghalaya's population was rural.
logic_rationale: 2,371,439 / 2,966,889 = 79.93%. This supports designing beyond urban social-media audiences.

claim_text: The DES portal lists 12 districts (2022) and 55 C&RD blocks (2022).
logic_rationale: Administrative spread makes repeatable district/block communication kits more useful than a Shillong-only content model.

claim_text: A 2022 Government RFP described connectivity and rural awareness as barriers to last-mile scheme uptake and called for grass-root Behaviour Change Communication.
logic_rationale: This is direct evidence that awareness alone is insufficient; communication must help people convert information into action.

claim_text: The same RFP specified village-level audience frameworks, communication in local languages and collection of citizen feedback/grievances.
logic_rationale: Localisation and feedback are explicit operating requirements in a real Meghalaya citizen-engagement mandate.

claim_text: MyMeG describes its purpose as participatory governance: capturing citizen feedback, disseminating government messages through multiple channels and engaging citizens in implementation.
logic_rationale: This supports a two-way communications model rather than a one-way publishing calendar.

claim_text: In the 2024 Independence Day speech, the Chief Minister explicitly linked terrain and distance to difficulty accessing government services and described CM-CONNECT as a response.
logic_rationale: The communication architecture should reduce distance through channel redundancy, field touchpoints and clear escalation paths.

claim_text: The same speech said the 1971 multilingual helpline had already been used by 12,000 citizens by August 2024.
logic_rationale: The helpline demonstrates that feedback/service channels are part of the communication system, not downstream of it.

claim_text: The Meghalaya State Language Act continues English as the official language and permits Khasi and Garo as associate official languages in specified district-level contexts.
logic_rationale: I would treat localisation as audience/context design, with language as one layer rather than a mechanical translation step.

claim_text: The 2021 Youth Policy estimated that more than 70% of Meghalaya's population was under 35 and also warned that youth are not a homogeneous group.
logic_rationale: Youth relevance is high, but segmentation by life situation, rural/urban context and needs matters more than generic youth tone.

claim_text: TRAI reported 2.08 million internet subscriptions in Meghalaya at March 2025, equal to 61.08 subscriptions per 100 population.
logic_rationale: Digital channels are material to reach, but subscription density is not the same as unique people reached.

claim_text: TRAI reported 49.45 internet subscriptions per 100 rural population versus 105.53 per 100 urban population in Meghalaya at March 2025.
logic_rationale: The gap argues for digital-plus-field distribution; urban figures above 100 also warn against reading subscription density as population penetration.

claim_text: Meghalaya DIPR describes daily press releases, press conferences/briefings, photo documentation, video production and field publicity within its remit.
logic_rationale: A communications consultant needs to work across earned, owned, visual and field formats rather than optimize one channel in isolation.

claim_text: DIPR also describes periodic Special Interactive Programmes across districts and sub-divisions for one-to-one citizen interaction with department officials.
logic_rationale: Face-to-face feedback and explanation remain part of the state's communication infrastructure.

claim_text: The MPOWER commitment plan requires stakeholder information to be timely, relevant, understandable, accessible and consultation to be culturally appropriate.
logic_rationale: I use these as quality gates for communication products, not merely stylistic preferences.
